stem_book: One hollow and one solid cylinder of the same outer radius roll down (without slipping) on a rough inclined plane. The foot of the inclined plane is reached by (a) solid cylinder earlier (b) hollow cylinder earlier (c) simultaneously (d) the heavier earlier irrespective of being solid or hollow
reason: Coordinator: printed 'smooth' changed to rough to match the key - not used. print says 'smooth' inclined plane, which contradicts 'rolls' (on a smooth plane both would slide and arrive together); corrected to rolling without slipping on a rough plane, matching printed key (a)
work: a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²): solid k²/R² = 1/2 ⇒ (2/3)g sinθ > hollow k²/R² = 1 ⇒ (1/2)g sinθ ⇒ solid first
